annotations.title: Add several people to the CRM

description: Add up to 100 people to the customer's connected CRM in the background. Each person is given by the profile_url that search_prospects or find_contact_details returned; anyone else is refused (add_person_to_crm adds one person from any profile link). People already in the CRM are skipped. Returns a job id for get_bulk_add_status. Uses one lookup credit for each person an e-mail address is found for.

include_phone.description: also look for mobile numbers; this uses extra credits for every person, so set it only when the customer wants phone numbers saved

only_with_email.description: add only the people an e-mail address is found for

people.description: the people to add, up to 100, each with the profile_url that search_prospects or find_contact_details returned in this conversation

company.description: the person's company, for the customer's reference; the stored record is used

name.description: the person's full name, for the customer's reference; the stored record is used

profile_url.description: link to the person's public profile page, exactly as search_prospects or find_contact_details returned it

title.description: the person's job title, for the customer's reference; the stored record is used

tags.description: tags to put on every record, in addition to the customer's default tags

name: add_people_to_crm

already_in_crm.description: people who were already in the CRM and were left alone

status.description: pending, processing, completed, failed or cancelled

title: Add several people to the CRM
